studyMetadata.title: Cut Vertex
studyMetadata.description: Counterbalanced cut vertex graph verification study with a tutorial.

verify_list_1_trial_01.instruction:
## Reminder: cut vertex

A cut vertex is a vertex whose removal disconnects the graph into separate parts.

response.prompt: Based on this visualization, does this graph have a cut vertex?

options.label: Yes, this graph has a cut vertex
No, this graph does not have a cut vertex
